exposure: working hours (7:00 am to 11:59 pm) vs. after-hours (12-6:59 am)
outcome: major neonatal morbidities (intraventricular hemorrhage, need for prolonged mechanical ventilation)
finding: No significant difference was found in neonatal mortality or major morbidities between infants born during working hours and those born after-hours, but 5-minute APGAR scores were significantly lower for infants born during working hours.
